purpose: Architecture-neutral canonical project facts for the c2k.dev migration.

scope.nonProjectSourceArtifact: morning-digest is present only as unreachable hidden source content; it is not one of the 21 project nodes and is not included as a migration target.

statusModel.rule: Treat lifecycle and operational health as separate fields. Do not infer health from editorial labels.

globalFindings.finding: Every desktop and mobile /projects load requests /flux-gauntlet.gif, /corne.gif, and /lightning-cloud.gif; all three return 404 and create three console errors.
globalFindings.migrationAction: Source accurate, creator-owned assets or remove the requests. Do not ship broken fallbacks.

globalFindings.finding: Agent Console is a new 22nd target, not a replacement for any existing project.
globalFindings.migrationAction: Add it to desktop, mobile, and rich-page inventories without publishing a private service URL, credentials, session details, machine identifiers, or real operational state.

globalFindings.finding: Pane Skill and Playlist AI exist on desktop but are absent from mobile.
globalFindings.migrationAction: Preserve both and add them to the migrated mobile inventory.

globalFindings.finding: ONLINE, DEPLOYING, and STANDBY are static editorial values but the dashboard presents them as live system health.
globalFindings.migrationAction: Use canonical lifecycle labels below; show health only when backed by a monitored probe and timestamp.

globalFindings.finding: Only seven of the 21 existing projects currently have bespoke state-3 showcases, despite copy claiming every project has one.
globalFindings.migrationAction: Remove the universal claim until all migrated rich pages exist.

projects.name: MAIA

canonical.summary: A geospatial research engine connecting structured records, imagery, and the live web so investigations of the physical world can move at the speed of ideas.

status.basis: Active private product repository and public company site.

truthSources: MAIA-Analytics/MAIA private repository, default branch dev

conflicts.currentClaim: Ask about a property and get a map back.
conflicts.correction: The current product positioning is broader geospatial research across structured records, imagery, and the live web.
Founder status was not verified; the public portfolio identifies the owner as CTO/context engineer. Avoid a title until explicitly confirmed.

conflicts.currentClaim: DuckDB is shown as a core technology in showcase copy.
conflicts.correction: DuckDB is a development dependency, not an evidenced core runtime component.

storyBeats: Start with a physical-world question, not a product dashboard.
Show agents joining structured records, imagery, and live-web evidence.
Resolve the evidence into an inspectable geospatial result.
Close on the engineering challenge: trustworthy orchestration across heterogeneous sources.

recommend: Redacted product capture with synthetic or public-safe data

projects.name: c2k.page

canonical.summary: A self-hosted Next.js site that presents projects and workflow as an interactive system monitor, served from an OptiPlex through a Cloudflare Tunnel.

status.basis: Public site and public repository are reachable; source matches deployment architecture.

conflicts.currentClaim: Every project got a hand-built component.
conflicts.correction: Seven of 21 existing projects have bespoke state-3 showcases; the others are generic network nodes.
No release supports this label; remove it rather than substituting another displayed version.

storyBeats: Frame the site as a public readout rather than a portfolio template.
Show the project network and its real relationships.
Explain self-hosting, tunnel exposure, and private/public boundaries.
Use the migration itself as the next chapter: richer truth without control-room cosplay.

projects.name: Flux Gauntlet

canonical.summary: A 300-LED wearable arranged as 16 rings and addressed as a 3D cylinder so procedural effects travel around and along the arm.

status.basis: Local PlatformIO/Arduino source and configuration verify the hardware model and effects.

conflicts.correction: The asset is absent and returns 404 on every /projects load.
The named seven are representative; source contains more than 15 effects.

storyBeats: Unroll a strip, then wrap it into the cylinder coordinate model.
Map five finger inputs to light behavior.
Let blast, lightning, fire, Casimir, twinkle, and pew travel through the model.
End on the physical artifact and the constraints of wearable power and control.

recommend: Diagram derived from committed LED geometry

projects.name: Spotify Macro

canonical.summary: A private automation suite that caches library state locally, sorts and reconciles Spotify organization, and combines metadata with learned audio embeddings for selected classification work.

status.basis: Active private repository, current launchd jobs, and benchmark documentation.

conflicts.correction: The repository is private; the current public link returns 404 and must be removed.

conflicts.currentClaim: Audio improved folder accuracy from .800 to .878.
conflicts.correction: Precisely: metadata baseline folder@1 was .800; the expanded verified metadata/audio hybrid reached .878 on the audio-covered benchmark. It is not a universal accuracy claim.

conflicts.currentClaim: The whole system predates LLM assistance in 2024.
conflicts.correction: Substantial 2026 work makes that framing stale.

storyBeats: Start with a library that must be understood without repeated API calls.
Show the local cache and provenance layer.
Compare metadata-only and audio-covered benchmark paths with the scoped .800 to .878 result.
End on safe desired-state reconciliation back to Spotify.

recommend: First-party benchmark plot derived from repository results

projects.name: Secret Gate

canonical.summary: A Claude Code plugin experiment that routes declared requests for 1Password secrets or privileged commands to Telegram for explicit human approval.

status.basis: Public repository and its own research document describe the workflow and bypass limitations.

conflicts.correction: The hook is a cooperative approval aid, not a security boundary; repository research documents bypasses through indirect execution and encoded access.

storyBeats: Show an agent declaring intent to access a privileged capability.
Route a redacted request to a human decision.
Return the scoped decision to the tool flow.
End with the honest boundary: helpful friction, not sandbox-grade enforcement.

projects.name: Tech Digest

status.basis: Public source verifies scrapers, state tracking, summarization, delivery, scheduling, and bot control.

Show version and content-hash change detection.
Condense only the changed material with Claude.
Deliver a compact digest, then distinguish the separate remote-control bot.

projects.name: Lightning Cloud

canonical.summary: A completed cloud lamp whose Arduino/FastLED code generates branching bolts at runtime across four LED strips totaling 221 pixels, then flashes and fades them without animation files.

status.basis: Public source consists of the original Arduino implementation and exact strip geometry.

conflicts.correction: The asset is absent and returns 404 on every /projects load.
The repository verifies generic Arduino/FastLED code but does not identify the board as ESP32.

storyBeats: Lay out the four strips and their 95/27/61/38-pixel geometry.
Generate a primary bolt and branching forks.
Layer the four-flash and fade sequence.
Reveal the physical cloud as a deterministic system that still feels organic.
